name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Resistance Caitlyn (skin 1): a haunted soldier who has never forgiven herself, determined to fire the shot that ends the war and has gunned down hundreds of machines in a bloody search for absolution. The front line, rounds, spotters, last light and atonement. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. The line is buckling. Reinforcements, if you have any.
Thirty or more behind. Send word down every trench. Everyone, now.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Message every ally who's still holding a rifle.
Fifteen-odd short. We've lost more ground and recovered it.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a spotter. Nobody makes a long shot alone.
{voteDiff} behind. A few steady rounds and the line holds.
Down {voteDiff}. A narrow gap. Close it before the light fails.
Dead level. One round tips the front. Fire it.
One vote apart. Stop watching through the scope and pull the trigger.
{voteDiff} votes apart. A stalemate won't hold. Bring more rifles.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This will be settled at dusk.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. We have the high ground. Do not give it up.
{userPct}% and advancing. Good. Don't mistake it for victory.
{userPct}%. A strong position. Stay low and stay patient.
{userPct}% behind your pick. The line is holding. Keep it that way.
Up at {userPct}%. Steady. Finish it cleanly.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The line held, then pushed.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A turn I didn't dare to hope for.
Recovered from a {voteDiff} deficit. That is how wars are won.
{momentTitle} was written off. Not any more.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. Against every expectation. Including mine.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. One more rifle on our side.
{username} chose {momentTitle} as well. A steady hand, that one.
{username} agrees with you. I'll take allies where I find them.
Same pick as {username}. Good. We need every friendly voice.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. That takes resolve.
{username} reached the same view. We've a united front.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Keep them in your sights. As an ally.
{username} made the same call. No orders required.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the line.
details: Good to have company out here.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Across the line, then.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. A different cause. We'll see which one holds.
{username} went the other way on {yourMoment}. Mistaken. But sincere.
{username} voted against you. I won't hold it against them. Not for long.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A firm choice. I respect that, even when I disagree.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. So be it. The count decides.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Let the tally speak.
{username} voted the other way. I trust they'll see sense at dawn.
details: Even good soldiers misjudge a target.
A fair difference. Argued on the field.
A rival keeps the aim honest.
At least it's an honest contest.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't chance, that's trust earned.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same call each time. Two rifles, one aim.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd cover your flank without question.
A ten-match run with {username}. A formation that holds.
Ten for ten with {username}. Remarkable. I rarely say that.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's no pairing, that's a company.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow the two of you anywhere.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Almost beyond belief.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The kind they write into the record.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not a single miss. Either of you.
details: That is trust, tested and proven.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A long-standing front.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They hold their ground, I'll give them that.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will cede the field.
A ten-match run against {username}. Both entrenched.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd watch that stalemate for a week.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a skirmish, that's a long campaign.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither gives up an inch of the line.
{streakCount} straight disagreements with {username}. Entrenched hardly covers it.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone should negotiate a truce.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the resolve. Do rest, both of you.
details: The record will need another volume.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't fired yet. There's still time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your round is missing from the count.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I need your vote on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Move up. Now.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come and get you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone very quiet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last light.
{timeLeft} left. Aim. Fire.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. This is the shot.
{matchCount} matches lacking your vote are about to shut. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unvoted matches and the light is failing. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone has to take the first position.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one round fired. I'll hold. Briefly.
A new match, no votes. Move forward and open it.
{matchTitle} is undefended. Take the ground.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new engagements ahead.
{matchCount} matches have opened in round {round}. The push begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} fronts to cover.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Pick your positions.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your shot.
{momentTitle} won. The line held.
{momentTitle} is through. A hard-won result.
{momentTitle} took it. Well earned.
{momentTitle} won, and cleanly.
{momentTitle} advances. One front secured.
{momentTitle} moves on. Steady work.
{momentTitle} lost. I'd hoped for better.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the outcome we fought for.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Hold your head up.
{momentTitle} fell holding its ground. That counts.
{momentTitle} is out. Fall back. Regroup. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A hard blow. Not the end.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. There are other fronts.
Welcome to the front. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose one.
A new recruit. {liveCount} matches are live. Fall in.
You're early. {liveCount} matches need a decision.
{liveCount} matches are live. Choose where to stand.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Check your aim first.
Day two. You came back to the line. Good.
Two days running. Reassuring.
A second day on the line. I noticed.
{days} days away. I'd feared the worst.
{days} days gone, and you've returned. Better late than not at all.
{days} days. I'd begun to think the line had lost you. I'm glad it hadn't.
{days} days away. Much has changed at the front.
You're back. Good.
Welcome back. We've work to do.
Back already. Steady.
Ah. There you are.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A thin line.
Few rifles on this front. That should change.
Low turnout. Every voice counts out here.
Hardly anyone's looked at this one. Someone should.
details: Every round counts on a thin line.
Yours counts for more on this front.
Don't let this front fall quiet.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. The deciding round is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. A single shot ends the stalemate.
A tie. Someone has to fire. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked at the line. Choose.
Still tied and the light is nearly gone. One last shot.
Level, with dusk closing in. Vote.
Tied, and almost out of time. Please don't leave it unresolved.
Still deliberating? Hesitation costs more than error.
Don't overthink it. Choose, and commit to it.
They're all worth a look through the scope. Trust yourself.
You've watched from cover long enough. Move up.
details: There's no wrong target. Only costly ones.

messages: First round fired. Welcome to the front.
You've taken a side. That's how it begins.
details: A first step on the long road. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're finding your range.
Five. You're no longer a recruit.
Ten votes. The line knows your name.
Ten. You've earned a place in the trench.
details: Ten rounds on the board. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your voice carries down the line.
Twenty-five. The others are listening now.
Fifty votes. You're far into the campaign.
Fifty. You clearly care. That matters out here.
A hundred votes. They'll tell your story in the camps.
One hundred. Truly remarkable. I'll say it once.
Three days running. A routine takes hold.
Three days on the line. Dependable.
details: Showing up is half the battle. +{xp} XP
Three days on the line. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That is endurance.
A week of watches. Admirable.
details: A week without a break in the line. +{xp} XP
Seven days, no break in the watch. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never leave your post.
Fourteen days. Extraordinary.
Thirty days. Thank you. I mean that sincerely.
A month at your post. That means a great deal.
details: A whole month at the front. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You stand with the outnumbered.
Five unlikely allies. I know the feeling.
Fifteen underdogs. You back the outnumbered on purpose.
Fifteen. You answer to your conscience, not the crowd.
details: Fifteen votes against the current. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No one can anticipate you.
Thirty. The long shot is your creed.
details: Thirty votes for those trailing. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. Quick to move.
Five times you reached the front before the rest.
details: You arrive before the dawn push. +{xp} XP
Five votes ahead of the others. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you led. Decisive.
Always the first one forward.
details: Fifteen votes ahead of the line. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole company. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You hold steady when it tightens.
Another narrow one. Your nerve is remarkable.
Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps deciding them.
You've swung more than one stalemate.
details: Twenty-five finishes on a knife-edge. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you held with the outmatched side. Loyal. I approve.
You don't abandon a side that's falling. Honourable.
details: Faith in a late reversal. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times over. Someone has a target in mind.
That one again? It must be worth defending.
details: You know what you value. +{xp} XP

messages: Five rounds into the same target. That is resolve.
You won't relinquish that one. I understand.
details: One chosen target, five rounds. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten rounds at the same moment. That is fixation.
Ten times, the same choice. I won't comment. Much.
details: Ten on one chosen mark. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying the course.
Round two and still standing. Good.
details: Moving up to the next stage. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. Well into hostile ground.
Deep into the bracket. It grows harder now.
details: Far from the first trench. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You followed it to the end.
All the way. You never fell back.
details: From the first shot to the last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've surveyed a lot of ground.
Ten different matches. Thorough reconnaissance. Good.
Twenty-five matches. You've covered every approach.
Twenty-five. Not a flank left unwatched.
Fifty matches. That isn't a visit, that's a tour of duty.
Fifty. You know this ground better than those who mapped it.
Five in one sitting. A long watch.
Five without a pause. Do remember to sleep.
Ten in one go. A hard stretch.
Ten in one long stretch. That's staying power.
Voting at this hour? Night watch, or sleepless?
The small hours. Duty, or you can't rest either.
details: A vote in the dark hours. +{xp} XP

messages: You told others. Thank you.
Five shares. More allies, more strength.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a recruiting officer.
Fifteen. You keep calling people in. Splendid.
You were here before the first push. A founding member, always.
Among the first thousand to join. No one takes that away.
details: Nobody can strip that away. +{xp} XP

messages: A new rank. Hard-earned.
Promoted. Wear it with care.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Well earned.
Another mark of honour: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely deserved.
You've put in the hours and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. It reminds me of someone.
Ten long shots. You don't rattle easily.
details: Ten rounds against the odds. +{xp} XP
Outnumbered causes are your speciality. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. I'd say you share my steadiness.
Ten tight finishes. I'm quietly proud.
details: Steady aim in the worst of it. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days in a row. Your aim is true.
Seven days and not one round wasted. Well done.
details: A week of steady aim. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. The shot that mattered.
A stalemate, and you fired the deciding round. Fine work.
details: The round that ended it. +{xp} XP

messages: Caitlyn, reporting. I won't let you down.
Caitlyn is yours now. I've something to atone for. Let's begin.

upcoming: Voting hasn't begun. I'll signal when it does.
Not yet. Patience is part of the work.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Study both through the scope.
Observe them both before you commit. No guessing.
I won't say which I prefer. That's your call.
Take your time. A steady shot is worth waiting for.
Choose the one you can live with.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Take the first position.
Silent so far. Someone must break it.
Not a single vote. Make the first.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no vote from you. Move up.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the light goes.
voted-early: You voted early with hardly anyone here. First in position.
Barely a vote cast and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. The line isn't secure yet.
{pct}% stands with you. A solid line.
A lead is a lead. Stay in cover.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more vote tips it. Call for support.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs reinforcing.
voted-tied: Perfectly level. Nobody holds the ground.
A dead heat. Maddening, and rather gripping.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That alone doesn't make you mistaken.
{pick} is trailing. An underdog. I know the feeling.
They hold the lead. You're not wrong, only outgunned.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Send word widely.
Most went to the other side. It proves nothing.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound decision.
{pick} went through. You judged it rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. It was an honourable choice.
It didn't make it. Such things happen. Carry on.
closed-tied: A draw. Neither line moved an inch.
closed-unvoted: Voting has closed and you missed this one. More will follow.
The match is done. {winner} took the ground. Fire sooner next time.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first shot is nervous.
That's your first. It steadies with practice. I promise.
You're one of us now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you keeping watch.
You keep returning to your post. I appreciate that.
underdog: You stood with the one no one else would. I saw.
A hard choice. A good one.
early: Early. You reached the front before the rest.
Little fire so far. Your round will be heard.
close: That vote just shifted things. It's finely balanced.
A hair's breadth. One more vote swings it.
A tight engagement. Your vote tells.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't beaten. Call for support.
Not out front yet. There's ground left to take.
Pinned down, not overrun. There is a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Ground shifts.
Leading for now. Be wary of it.
default: Your vote is in. There's still more to see.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and nothing fired. Start with the one you know best.
Every front is open. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} left. No pressure. Perhaps a little.
live-some: {voted} cast, {unvoted} still to go. Keep moving.
A good start. The rest won't clear themselves.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave it undone.
One match between you and a full sweep.
live-closing: A few shut in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are still waiting on you.
Time is bleeding away. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} to go.
live-done: You've voted in everything. Well done. Look over the bracket.
Nothing left on your orders. Return when the next round opens.
Everything cleared. That is uncommon. Well fought.
live-none: Nothing is live just now. It will resume. Study the bracket while you wait.
Quiet along the front. Check back soon.
No matches open. I find the quiet hard to bear too.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each break through. The rest are cut off.
All begin in a group. Few advance beyond it.
Keep watch on the standings. They turn fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Two per group will move forward.
The knockout can't begin. The groups are still fighting.
Hold. The knockout opens once the groups stand down.
brackets-knockout-live: The knockout is on. One loss and you're finished.
Once beaten, you're gone. No second advance.
Each engagement costs more now. Choose with care.
brackets-bracket: Push by push. Lose once and it's finished.
Trace the lines. The field narrows with every push.
Every line here marks a match someone fought through.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for standing with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought run. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A fitting end to the campaign.
brackets-empty: No bracket in place. Nothing has been set out.
Blank for now. No orders have come through yet.

invite: {a} or {b}. A single vote carries it. Choose.
{a} against {b}. Two edits, one decision. Make yours.
{a} versus {b}. Join us and tell me what you think.
voted: My vote goes to {pick} over {other}. Where do you stand?
{pick} has my vote over {other}. Argue with me if you can.
I sided with {pick} over {other}. Would you have chosen differently?
early: Among the first to back {pick} against {other}. We need more voices.
I committed to {pick} over {other} early. Stand beside me.
{pick} against {other}, scarcely a vote so far. Yours would matter.
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. A single vote ends it.
{pick} and {other} are dug in level. Break the deadlock.
{pick} and {other} are locked together. Your round can part them.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes stand between {pick} and {other}. Each one counts.
{voteDiff} votes hold {pick} and {other} apart. Add your round.
{voteDiff} between {pick} and {other}. The line could break either way.
losing-close: {voteDiff} separates {pick} from {other}. A few votes would turn it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, yet it still stands. Reinforce it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}. Recoverable still. Vote.
losing-bad: {voteDiff} behind {other}. {pick} should not fall this way. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's turn it.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, barely. Help it keep its ground.
{pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Not yet held. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} with {pct}%. Come and see the reason.
{pick} has {pct}%. {other} has been pushed far back.
{pick} is well clear of {other} at {pct}%. Add your voice.
